I'm going to add to this whilst I watch if that's ok as I'll forget by the end

5mins in and it's already explained why a few of my trades have been stopped.

So the LL has to be in a PAZ. If it's reacted to an important FL the setup is over before it started.

Likewise with the HH. This needs to be a reaction to an important FL, most likely an MPL?

And thinking about a lot of the retail guys I know they do things like wait for a 4hour candle to close under previous swing high before selling, or wait for 20-30 pips of RT before jumping in putting stops just above previous swing high.

So the reason for the HH of the QM is to collect every single last SL. Which IF is now explaining lol.

Haha me and josh are the same as Red. Missing TG by a pip or two is worse than losing a trade.
